stories.headline: Stock Markets Hit a Record High as Investors Pour Back In
stories.summary: Share prices closed at an all-time high after three straight weeks of gains. Banks and IT companies led the rally as overseas investors returned. Analysts warn the run could cool if oil prices rise again.
stories.why_it_matters: Your SIPs and mutual funds are likely up this month.
stories.alt_text: Glowing green stock chart climbing to a record high.

stories.headline: New Space Telescope Spots Signs of Water on a Distant Planet
stories.summary: Astronomers say the telescope picked up water vapour in the air of a planet about 120 light-years away. It is one of the clearest readings yet, and the team plans follow-up observations next year.
stories.why_it_matters: It narrows the hunt for worlds that could support life.
stories.alt_text: Rocket climbing through a starry sky above Earth.

stories.headline: Underdogs Chase Down 320 to Win a Thrilling Series Decider
stories.summary: Needing 320 to win, the visitors got home with two balls to spare after a record sixth-wicket stand. It is their first series win away from home in eleven years.
stories.alt_text: Floodlit cricket stadium at night with a packed crowd.

stories.headline: Monsoon Arrives a Week Early, Farmers Brace for Sowing Season
stories.summary: The weather office says rains reached the coast seven days ahead of schedule. Early showers help farmers plant on time, but officials say the next two weeks will decide how good the harvest is.
stories.why_it_matters: Good rains usually mean cheaper vegetables later in the year.
stories.alt_text: Red umbrella in heavy rain over green fields.

stories.headline: Electric Buses Now Outnumber Diesel Ones in Three Big Cities
stories.summary: City transport data shows e-buses make up more than half of the fleet in three metros. Operators say running costs are about 40% lower, and 2,000 more buses are on order.
stories.why_it_matters: Cleaner air and quieter streets on your daily commute.
stories.alt_text: Green electric bus driving through a city at dusk.
